blocks.en: How ReLEAF chose three plant protectants and engineered one of them: the GRAFT methodology behind the docking workflow, the design sprints it produced, and the molecular dynamics that tested the result.
blocks.text: How ReLEAF chose three plant protectants and engineered one of them: the GRAFT methodology behind the docking workflow, the design sprints it produced, and the molecular dynamics that tested the result.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 如何挑出三種植物保護劑，又如何對其中一種進行工程改造：對接流程背後的 GRAFT 方法學、由它產出的設計衝刺，以及用來檢驗結果的分子動力學。
蛋白質設計

blocks.en: The dry lab work that chose ReLEAF’s three protectants and decided what to change in each before any DNA was ordered.
blocks.text: The dry lab work that chose ReLEAF’s three protectants and decided what to change in each before any DNA was ordered.
blocks.zh: 乾實驗的工作：挑出 ReLEAF 的三種保護劑，並在訂購任何 DNA 之前決定各自要改什麼。

blocks.en: They are BoPEP4, a Brassica oleracea plant elicitor peptide, LEA14, a late embryogenesis abundant protein, and ACC (1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate) deaminase. The binding sites themselves turned out to have almost no headroom, so the engineering moved to the construct and the delivery.
blocks.text: They are BoPEP4, a Brassica oleracea plant elicitor peptide, LEA14, a late embryogenesis abundant protein, and ACC (1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate) deaminase. The binding sites themselves turned out to have almost no headroom, so the engineering moved to the construct and the delivery.
blocks.zh: 它們是 BoPEP4，一種來自 Brassica oleracea 的植物激發子胜肽；LEA14，一種晚期胚胎發生豐富蛋白；以及 ACC（1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate）去胺酶。結果發現，結合位本身幾乎沒有可改的餘裕，因此工程改造轉向構築與遞送。

blocks.en: It is a record of what we got wrong and caught in time. A purification tag every earlier check had approved turned out, once simulated, to abolish the one contact the peptide depends on. The largest gain available on ACC deaminase, an enzyme, is a change to the medium it works in.
blocks.text: It is a record of what we got wrong and caught in time. A purification tag every earlier check had approved turned out, once simulated, to abolish the one contact the peptide depends on. The largest gain available on ACC deaminase, an enzyme, is a change to the medium it works in.
blocks.zh: 這也是一份我們做錯、但及時發現的紀錄。一個先前每道檢查都放行的純化標籤，一經模擬才發現它會消除胜肽所依賴的那一個接觸。至於 ACC 去胺酶這個酵素，能取得的最大改善是改變它作用的介質。

blocks.en: Three protectants, three sends. Each lane holds two boxes: what went out, with the reason protein design chose it and a link to the run it came from, and below it what was considered and rejected. The second box matters as much as the first, because what was ruled out, and on what evidence, is the other half of the result.
blocks.text: Three protectants, three sends. Each lane holds two boxes: what went out, with the reason protein design chose it and a link to the run it came from, and below it what was considered and rejected. The second box matters as much as the first, because what was ruled out, and on what evidence, is the other half of the result.
blocks.zh: 三種保護劑，三次送出。每一欄有兩個方塊：上面是送出去的東西，附上蛋白質設計挑中它的理由，以及連到它所出自的那次運算；下面是考慮過但否決的。第二個方塊和第一個一樣重要，因為什麼被排除、依據什麼證據被排除，是結果的另一半。
胜肽 · 整套階梯一起送出

blocks.en: A 23-residue peptide that switches on the plant’s own stress response by binding a receptor, PEPR1. A shorter peptide is cheaper for the bioreactor to make, so the question was how much could be cut from the front before it stopped working. Nothing computational separated the best candidates, so the whole ladder went out and the concentration decides.
blocks.text: A 23-residue peptide that switches on the plant’s own stress response by binding a receptor, PEPR1. A shorter peptide is cheaper for the bioreactor to make, so the question was how much could be cut from the front before it stopped working. Nothing computational separated the best candidates, so the whole ladder went out and the concentration decides.
blocks.zh: 一段 23 個胺基酸殘基的胜肽，藉由結合受體 PEPR1 來啟動植物自身的逆境反應。胜肽越短，生物反應器製造起來越便宜，所以問題是前端能切掉多少而不失去作用。計算上分不出最好的那幾個候選，因此整套階梯全部送出，由濃度來決定。
送進濕實驗

blocks.en: Full length. The reference every shorter rung is measured against.
blocks.text: Full length. The reference every shorter rung is measured against.
blocks.zh: 全長。每一個較短的階都以它為對照基準。
截短階梯 →

blocks.en: Best of the series once simulated: the grip on the receptor held 98.5% of the time against 77.1% for the shorter rung below.
blocks.text: Best of the series once simulated: the grip on the receptor held 98.5% of the time against 77.1% for the shorter rung below.
blocks.zh: 經模擬後是這一系列中最好的：對受體的抓附在 98.5% 的時間維持住，而下面較短的那一階是 77.1%。
截短階梯 →

blocks.en: Cheapest to make, at 33% less mass, with the contacts that anchor it still intact.
blocks.text: Cheapest to make, at 33% less mass, with the contacts that anchor it still intact.
blocks.zh: 最便宜製造的一個，質量少了 33%，而把它錨定住的那些接觸仍然完好。
截短階梯 →

blocks.en: Cut past the point where the modeling says it breaks. Nine residues is too short to reach along the receptor groove, so this is the ladder’s own negative.
blocks.text: Cut past the point where the modeling says it breaks. Nine residues is too short to reach along the receptor groove, so this is the ladder’s own negative.
blocks.zh: 切過了建模認為會失效的那一點。九個殘基太短，無法沿著受體溝槽延伸，所以這是這套階梯自己的陰性對照。
截短階梯 →

blocks.en: A deliberate failure. Published at more than 4000-fold weaker, it calibrates the assay every other activity claim rests on.
blocks.text: A deliberate failure. Published at more than 4000-fold weaker, it calibrates the assay every other activity claim rests on.
blocks.zh: 刻意的失敗版本。文獻報告它的活性弱了 4000 倍以上，用它來校正其他所有活性說法所依據的那項檢測。

blocks.en: The second control, published at roughly 100-fold weaker. No substitution meant to improve the peptide was ordered, because none was found worth ordering.
blocks.text: The second control, published at roughly 100-fold weaker. No substitution meant to improve the peptide was ordered, because none was found worth ordering.
blocks.zh: 第二個對照，文獻報告弱約 100 倍。沒有訂購任何意在改良胜肽的置換，因為找不到值得訂的。
全部N 端 6×His

blocks.en: The purification tag goes on the front. On the back it caps the one chemical group that forms the peptide’s strongest contact with the receptor, which would have given a molecule that purifies well and cannot work.
blocks.text: The purification tag goes on the front. On the back it caps the one chemical group that forms the peptide’s strongest contact with the receptor, which would have given a molecule that purifies well and cannot work.
blocks.zh: 純化標籤放在前端。放在後端時，它會封住形成胜肽與受體最強接觸的那個化學基團，結果會得到一個容易純化、卻無法作用的分子。
N-His 對 C-His →
考慮過但否決

blocks.en: The contact it was built on held only half the time once simulated, so the reason for making it went away.
blocks.text: The contact it was built on held only half the time once simulated, so the reason for making it went away.
blocks.zh: 它所依據的那個接觸，一經模擬只維持了一半的時間，所以做它的理由就消失了。

blocks.en: The two prediction methods disagreed on this one more sharply than on anything else in the project.
blocks.text: The two prediction methods disagreed on this one more sharply than on anything else in the project.
blocks.zh: 在這一個上，兩種預測方法的分歧比專題中其他任何一項都更嚴重。

blocks.en: The strongest binders of the whole panel. Trimming two residues saves too little to be worth making.
blocks.text: The strongest binders of the whole panel. Trimming two residues saves too little to be worth making.
blocks.zh: 整組之中結合最強的幾個。少掉兩個殘基省下的太少，不值得做。
串聯重複

blocks.en: Ruled out on chemistry alone: only the last copy in a chain keeps the end group the peptide needs.
blocks.text: Ruled out on chemistry alone: only the last copy in a chain keeps the end group the peptide needs.
blocks.zh: 單憑化學就排除了：一條串鏈裡只有最後一個拷貝保留胜肽所需的末端基團。
摺疊蛋白質 · 五個 N-His 構築

blocks.en: A 151-residue plant protein that helps cells survive drying and salt. It is not an enzyme: one copy protects one thing and is not reused, so the only ways to get more effect are to deliver more copies or make each copy do more. These five test both, by trimming the loose ends and by bolting on a membrane-binding motif it does not naturally have.
blocks.text: A 151-residue plant protein that helps cells survive drying and salt. It is not an enzyme: one copy protects one thing and is not reused, so the only ways to get more effect are to deliver more copies or make each copy do more. These five test both, by trimming the loose ends and by bolting on a membrane-binding motif it does not naturally have.
blocks.zh: 一種 151 個殘基的植物蛋白質，幫助細胞撐過乾燥與鹽。它不是酵素：一個拷貝保護一個對象，而且不會被重複使用，所以要得到更多效果，只能送進更多拷貝，或讓每個拷貝做更多事。這五個同時測這兩條路：修掉鬆散的末端，以及接上一段它天生沒有的膜結合模組。
送進濕實驗

blocks.en: Adds an ability LEA14 lacks. The K-segment sticks to membranes as a cell dries; LEA14 cannot do this on its own, so this asks whether borrowing it makes each copy count for more.
blocks.text: Adds an ability LEA14 lacks. The K-segment sticks to membranes as a cell dries; LEA14 cannot do this on its own, so this asks whether borrowing it makes each copy count for more.
blocks.zh: 加上 LEA14 所缺的一項能力。細胞乾燥時，K-segment 會黏附在膜上；LEA14 自己做不到這件事，因此這一個是在問，借來這段序列能不能讓每個拷貝更有用。
LEA14 的各次運算 →

blocks.en: The same addition on a trimmed background, so the pair below isolates exactly what the K-segment contributes.
blocks.text: The same addition on a trimmed background, so the pair below isolates exactly what the K-segment contributes.
blocks.zh: 同樣的加法，但接在修短過的背景上，因此下面那一對正好能分離出 K-segment 的貢獻。
LEA14 的各次運算 →

blocks.en: The matched control: the same trim with no K-segment. Comparing these two is the experiment.
blocks.text: The matched control: the same trim with no K-segment. Comparing these two is the experiment.
blocks.zh: 配對的對照：同樣的修短，但沒有 K-segment。把這兩個相比，就是這個實驗。
保守性序列比對 →

blocks.en: The deeper front trim. The first 23 residues have no fixed shape in the solved structure, and loose ends are where protein-chewing enzymes start.
blocks.text: The deeper front trim. The first 23 residues have no fixed shape in the solved structure, and loose ends are where protein-chewing enzymes start.
blocks.zh: 更深的前端修短。在解出的結構裡，前 23 個殘基沒有固定形狀，而鬆散的末端正是分解蛋白質的酵素下手的地方。
保守性序列比對 →

blocks.en: The back end instead. Those last six residues are loose and water-repelling, which is the usual starting point for copies clumping together into something useless.
blocks.text: The back end instead. Those last six residues are loose and water-repelling, which is the usual starting point for copies clumping together into something useless.
blocks.zh: 改從後端下手。最後那六個殘基鬆散且疏水，而那通常就是拷貝互相聚集成無用團塊的起點。
LEA14 上的 WHISCY →

blocks.en: not sentNo model of the complex
blocks.text: not sentNo model of the complex
blocks.zh: 未送出沒有複合體的模型

blocks.en: A confidence threshold set before the result came back was failed, while two control predictions of the same kind passed. So no structure of LEA14 with its partner was handed on, by prior agreement.
blocks.text: A confidence threshold set before the result came back was failed, while two control predictions of the same kind passed. So no structure of LEA14 with its partner was handed on, by prior agreement.
blocks.zh: 一個在結果回來之前就訂好的信賴度門檻沒有通過，而同類的兩個對照預測則通過了。因此依先前的約定，沒有交出 LEA14 與其夥伴的結構。
AlphaFold 門檻 →
考慮過但否決
更緊的夥伴結合

blocks.en: Skipped. The published work disagrees on whether LEA14 protects its partner or blocks it, so tighter binding could help or harm.
blocks.text: Skipped. The published work disagrees on whether LEA14 protects its partner or blocks it, so tighter binding could help or harm.
blocks.zh: 略過。已發表的工作對於 LEA14 是保護它的夥伴還是阻擋它並無定論，因此結合更緊可能有益，也可能有害。
BP100 入胞標籤

blocks.en: Held. There is no assay here that can tell protein inside a plant cell from protein stuck to the outside, so the result would be unreadable.
blocks.text: Held. There is no assay here that can tell protein inside a plant cell from protein stuck to the outside, so the result would be unreadable.
blocks.zh: 保留不做。這裡沒有任何檢測能分辨進到植物細胞內的蛋白質與黏在外面的蛋白質，所以結果會無法判讀。
葉綠體導入標籤

blocks.en: Held. A plausible mechanism with no published test of an applied protein behind it.
blocks.text: Held. A plausible mechanism with no published test of an applied protein behind it.
blocks.zh: 保留不做。機制說得通，但背後沒有任何關於外加蛋白質的已發表測試。
ACC 去胺酶
酵素 · 沒有送出任何突變體

blocks.en: A bacterial enzyme that lowers plant stress by eating ACC, the molecule plants turn into the stress hormone ethylene. Unlike the other two it is a true catalyst, so one copy works over and over. That is why the decisive result here is not a mutation.
blocks.text: A bacterial enzyme that lowers plant stress by eating ACC, the molecule plants turn into the stress hormone ethylene. Unlike the other two it is a true catalyst, so one copy works over and over. That is why the decisive result here is not a mutation.
blocks.zh: 一種 細菌酵素，藉由吃掉 ACC 來降低植物的逆境，而 ACC 正是植物用來轉成逆境激素乙烯的那個分子。和另外兩者不同，它是真正的催化劑，一個拷貝可以一再作用。這也是為什麼這裡決定性的結果不是一個突變。
送進濕實驗
僅野生型ACC 去胺酶野生型

blocks.en: No mutant was sent. The enzyme meets far less ACC than it could handle, so how much working enzyme is present matters more than how good the enzyme is. On the modeling, the largest gain available is a change to the conditions it works in instead of to the protein, which is why no variant was ordered.
blocks.text: No mutant was sent. The enzyme meets far less ACC than it could handle, so how much working enzyme is present matters more than how good the enzyme is. On the modeling, the largest gain available is a change to the conditions it works in instead of to the protein, which is why no variant was ordered.
blocks.zh: 沒有送出任何突變體。這個酵素碰到的 ACC 遠少於它能處理的量，所以現場有多少有活性的酵素，比酵素本身有多好更重要。就建模結果看，能取得的最大改善是改變它作用的條件，而不是改蛋白質，這就是沒有訂任何變異體的原因。
保守性與穩定性篩選 →
已設計C41V、C67A、C162A、C282A

blocks.en: A version with four of its six reactive sulfur groups removed, which should keep longer in storage. Designed and held for a season with bench capacity. Two of the six stay, both buried where they cannot cause trouble.
blocks.text: A version with four of its six reactive sulfur groups removed, which should keep longer in storage. Designed and held for a season with bench capacity. Two of the six stay, both buried where they cannot cause trouble.
blocks.zh: 一個移除了六個反應性硫基中四個的版本，保存時應該能撐得更久。已完成設計，但因實驗檯量能而擱置一季。六個中有兩個留下，都埋在不會出問題的位置。
移除未配對的半胱胺酸 →
考慮過但否決

blocks.en: Would staple the fold together with a new cysteine. The family keeps an aromatic here in 97% of cases and the stability screen fails it. It was also designed against the wrong organism’s sequence, which is how the naming error was caught.
blocks.text: Would staple the fold together with a new cysteine. The family keeps an aromatic here in 97% of cases and the stability screen fails it. It was also designed against the wrong organism’s sequence, which is how the naming error was caught.
blocks.zh: 原本要用一個新的半胱胺酸把摺疊釘在一起。這個家族在這個位置有 97% 的情況保留芳香族殘基，而穩定性篩選也不通過。它還是對著錯誤生物的序列設計的，命名錯誤就是這樣被抓到的。

blocks.en: The only route to shifting the working pH. Self-rated at 25% before any calculation, and conservation and stability both came back against it.
blocks.text: The only route to shifting the working pH. Self-rated at 25% before any calculation, and conservation and stability both came back against it.
blocks.zh: 這是唯一能移動作用 pH 的途徑。在任何計算之前，自評成功機會為 25%，而保守性與穩定性兩項結果都不支持它。

blocks.en: Shifts the pH as intended but costs tenfold activity to do it, which is worse than where it started.
blocks.text: Shifts the pH as intended but costs tenfold activity to do it, which is worse than where it started.
blocks.zh: 確實如預期移動了 pH，但代價是活性少十倍，比出發點更差。
精胺酸夾持

blocks.en: Every related enzyme grips the substrate with an arginine; this family does not. There is nowhere in the crowded pocket to put one.
blocks.text: Every related enzyme grips the substrate with an arginine; this family does not. There is nowhere in the crowded pocket to put one.
blocks.zh: 每一個相關的酵素都用一個精胺酸抓住受質；這個家族沒有。擁擠的口袋裡也沒有地方放。

blocks.en: A short stretch, EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG, found in related plant proteins. It sticks to membranes and protects them as a cell dries out. LEA14 has no such stretch of its own.
blocks.text: A short stretch, EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG, found in related plant proteins. It sticks to membranes and protects them as a cell dries out. LEA14 has no such stretch of its own.
blocks.zh: 一段短序列 EKKGIMDKIKEKLPG，出現在相關的植物蛋白質中。細胞乾燥時它會黏附在膜上並保護膜。LEA14 自己沒有這樣的序列。

blocks.en: A flexible linker of five small residues. It joins the K-segment to LEA14 without either half interfering with how the other folds.
blocks.text: A flexible linker of five small residues. It joins the K-segment to LEA14 without either half interfering with how the other folds.
blocks.zh: 由五個小殘基組成的柔性連接子。它把 K-segment 接到 LEA14 上，而兩半都不會干擾對方的摺疊。

blocks.en: Six histidines added to one end so the protein can be pulled out of a mixture and purified. Which end it goes on is a design decision, not a formality.
blocks.text: Six histidines added to one end so the protein can be pulled out of a mixture and purified. Which end it goes on is a design decision, not a formality.
blocks.zh: 在一端加上六個組胺酸，讓蛋白質能從混合物中被拉出來純化。接在哪一端是一項設計決定，不是形式。

blocks.en: Truncations. The number range is the piece removed, counted from the start of the protein.
blocks.text: Truncations. The number range is the piece removed, counted from the start of the protein.
blocks.zh: 截短。數字範圍是被移除的那一段，從蛋白質的起點算起。

attrs.en: Protein Design. A white ribbon render of the receptor with a peptide chain in blue sticks lying along it, the contact distances labelled.
attrs.zh: 蛋白質設計。受體的白色綵帶圖，一條以藍色棒狀表示的胜肽鏈沿著它躺著，並標出接觸距離。

attrs.en: Flow chart of the protein design workflow, from literature and protectant families through mutation ideation, restraint mapping and conformer generation into docking, AI co-folding and structure scoring.
attrs.zh: 蛋白質設計流程的流程圖，從文獻與保護劑家族，經過突變構想、限制條件標定與構形生成，進入對接、AI 共摺疊與結構評分。

attrs.en: Bar chart of the BoPEP4 alanine scan against PEPR1, one bar per residue from Ser6 to Asn23, with binding hotspots, structural signals and mutation-tolerant positions in three colours.
attrs.zh: BoPEP4 對 PEPR1 的丙胺酸掃描長條圖，從 Ser6 到 Asn23 每個殘基一根長條，以三種顏色標示結合熱點、結構訊號與可容忍突變的位置。

attrs.en: Molecular surface of the PEPR1 binding groove with the C-terminal end of the BoPEP4 peptide, Asn23, buried in a pocket at the closed end.
attrs.zh: PEPR1 結合溝槽的分子表面，BoPEP4 胜肽的 C 端 Asn23 埋在封閉端的一個口袋裡。
